name: Back in Stock Notifier for WooCommerce by WPPOOL
author: WPPOOL

sections.description:
Website | Blog | Tutorials | Live Demo

🔥 Send in stock notifications to customers’ WhatsApp and phone when requested products come back in stock. 🔥

Let’s grow, connect, and thrive together!

  • 🤝 Join Our Facebook Community
  • 🌐 Follow Us on X (Twitter)
  • 🎥 Subscribe on YouTube
  • 👍 Like Our Facebook Page

One of the biggest annoyances of managing a WooCommerce store is taking care of regular product stock. On top of that, you need to ensure that you are keeping track of customers’ stock requests and letting them know once they are back in stock. Sounds complicated, right? You can now make it easier using a back in stock plugin on your website.

Back in Stock enhances the functionality of your online store. It keeps track of your product’s stock and sends instant messages as ** in-stock notifications** to the customers. This inventory plugin does it all. 🤩

👁️ View Demo | 🚀 Get PRO | 👩🏼‍💻 Get Support | 🤝 Join Our Facebook Community

We know it is a hard job to manage thousands of products as a store owner. 🥵It’s always pretty tricky to keep track of out of stock products and customer requests. In addition, you have to ensure which product variations are in stock and maintain stock requests.

🎅 The automated in stock notifications features of the plugin will take care of all that. It will also make your customers happier because it saves them from regularly checking the product stock. On the other hand, it grows your store sales too!

⭐ Count this plugin as a reliable integration as it builds trust and a sense of urgency in your customers. Send real-time notifications, save customers’ time, and create good communication. Whether your platform is small or big, busy or not, customers are the only ones to fuel your business growth. A fast interaction makes you trustworthy and grows your sales. Managing the waitlist has never been this easy. 💰

🛒 Multivendor Support || Dokan Multivendor Marketplace Plugin: Stock Notifier is fully compatible with the Dokan Multivendor Marketplace plugin. Dokan maintains multiple numbers of vendors from one place, and this plugin keeps related stock data for each of the vendors. It also sends instant WhatsApp messages to its customers once the product is back in stock. Overall, the plugin works as an excellent combination for multivendor marketplaces like Dokan. 💸

🤝 Let’s track the customers’ demand and give vendor owners a more hassle-free experience with WhatsApp in stock notification. 💁‍♂️

🚀 Growth doesn’t rely on sales only. It’s about managing your whole business smartly. Handling customers’ demand properly is the main priority to secure an uprising graph. 📈

👁️ View Demo | 🚀 Get PRO | 👩🏼‍💻 Get Support | 🤝 Join Our Facebook Community

🤩 Back in Stock Notifier for WooCommerce Free Features:

  • 💸 WooCommerce and Dokan Multivendor Integration: This plugin can be easily activated on multivendor stores for the WooCommerce marketplace using the Dokan plugin. This waitlist plugin allows you to receive real-time notifications on the screen and let customers know when their products are back in stock. It is a quick and easy way to feel connected to your customers and their needs.

  • 📲 WhatsApp Gateway: Get in-stock notifications through WhatsApp. The modern world depends on fast communication. Connect your WhatsApp number with the store simply through Chat API or Twilio. Sending sales notifications is no longer complicated!

  • 📸Image Notification via SMS: With Image Alerts, send stock notifications that showcase your products visually, grabbing attention and driving more sales effortlessly.

  • ✉️Email Integration: Notify customers automatically via email when products are back in stock. When customers request stock for a product, they will receive a restock alert email to their email address as soon as the product is available again.

  • 📱 International Phone number Validation: Manage customers from all over the world. Customers from different countries can subscribe easily by registering with their country code. They can easily find their living country by choosing their flag or entering the country code and phone number. All they need is the WhatsApp connection on their device.
  • 💬 Call to Action: Your subscribed audience gets a call to action button with the product status. They need to click the button to request stock. That’s it. They’ll get SMS automatically when the product is back in stock. This is the reliable WordPress plugin to customize the product page.
  • 🌟 Advanced WooCommerce waitlist Plugin: Stay updated on your product’s in-stock status from your end. Stock Notifier will do the rest by notifying your customers to request stock. It’ll activate automatically and send instant messages to the customer who searched for an out-of-stock product as a real-time in-stock notification.
  • 📜 Available Shortcodes: Manage your store with available shortcodes. Stock Notifier gets more straightforward and hassle-free. Managing your online store is not a challenging task anymore.
  • 📃 All subscriber list: All the subscribed audiences will be listed in order. You’ll get an idea through the list in an organized way.
  • 💬 Subscriber form hide option for logged-in/non-logged-in users: Get a chance to show or hide the subscriber form to your users.
  • 🎲 SMS Customization: Stock Notifier usually sends messages automatically by default. But it’ll also give you the option of sending SMS manually.
  • 👆 Subscriber form on the WooCommerce store page: Easily get an option to show or hide the subscriber form on the shop page. If you want to show your product on a single page, you’re always welcome to pick the option. Click on the slider to show or hide the subscriber form from the front. This can be an alternative to the WordPress contact form.

👁️ View Demo | 🚀 Get PRO | 👩🏼‍💻 Get Support | 🤝 Join Our Facebook Community

💰 Back in Stock Notifier for WooCommerce PRO Features:

  • 🎡 Product Visibility: Showcase your shop inventory with different types of products. Also, choose specific audiences for your products. If you want to hide any of your products from your logged-in audience, you’ll get the option quickly from your end. Enjoy in-depth product customization.
  • 🛒 Backorder product visibility: Showcase option for your backorder products. It’s a valuable feature for both vendors and customers.
  • 🛍 Product out-of-stock visibility: Get an option for showing or hiding your out-of-stock products to your customers.
  • 🤘 Custom Messages: It gives you all the options for customizing messages and back-in-stock notifications in your own language. It also automatically inserts the product name and customer name.
  • ⬆ Export option: Get all the subscriber data in one place with the export option. Download subscribers’ data anytime and collect your necessary information.
  • 📈 Per month data show: It collects your Product popularity, SMS data, subscriber data, etc., and keeps the record. You can collect that data anytime and compare regular updates.
  • 📊 Updated notification chart bar: It shows sent, pending, and failed notifications with chart bars.
  • 📈 Monthly sign-up chart bar: Provides monthly sign-up data for each vendor.
  • 📃 Total subscriber chart bar: It keeps data for the total subscription track record. Collect vendor subscription data anytime you want from the chart bar.
  • 🛒 Multi-Vendor Settings: It has an option for Multivendor marketplace. Multiple vendors can showcase their product stock in one place and take requests for stock for their store visitors.
  • 💁‍♂️ Specific vendor product showcase: Showcase all the products to your users, mentioning vendors specifically.
  • 🗨️ WP SMS Integration: Integration with WP SMS allows you to send SMS directly to your customers’ phone through more than 150 SMS gateways. You can take full advantage of this integration and use your preferred gateway.
  • 💥 Custom CSS: Make your store design with your style. Customize almost everything with the custom CSS feature of Stock Notifier. Customize your site’s appearance with this feature easily.
  • 📜 Default country selection: Free your customers from the hassle of choosing a country code every time they request a product stock. Choose a preferred default country from the plugin settings, and it will set the corresponding country code by default on the product page.
  • 📊 Stock progress bar: Displays a gorgeous stock progress bar on the products page with helpful information, including how many products are left in stock. It can help the customers learn more about your product’s popularity and result in more sales.
  • 🗨️ Twilio SMS Integration: Already have a Twilio account? With our Twilio SMS integration, quickly reach 180+ countries reliably with localized senders, powerful tools, and global guidelines.

👁️ View Demo | 🚀 Get PRO | 👩🏼‍💻 Get Support | 🤝 Join Our Facebook Community

💰 Back in Stock Notifier for WooCommerce Ultimate Features:

  • 📑All Pro Features

  • 📑 Individual Vendor Subscriber list: Stock Notifier gives an option for including individual subscriber data. Once you enter the necessary data and contact info in the backend, it will be saved on the dashboard and automatically show up on the front-end of the store.

  • 📑 Specific subscriber category showcase: Collect different lists for different categorized subscribers.
  • 📑 Specific subscriber tag visibility: Collect lists for subscribers of different tags of your vendors.
  • 📑 Specific subscriber product visibility: Collect lists for subscribers for each specific product.
  • 💹 Product popularity chart bar: This shows multiple chart bars for different products. Quickly get updates about the popular product.
  • 📉 Vendor popularity chart bar: Same as product popularity chart bar. It displays chart bars for vendor popularity.
  • 🎁 Different types of Product options: Store simple products, variable products, and group products in your inventory. Your customers will get in stock notifications of their specific criteria. Suppose you have a t-shirt to display in your store. You can showcase this product in different colors and sizes in one place, send the message to your audience with the specific one they searched for, and request stock if the product is unavailable.
  • 💹 On-sale product out of stock visibility: Get a showcase option for on-sale products of your vendor.
  • 💬 Theme configuration overwrite option: Use Stock Notifier with a stress-free style. It will not conflict with the theme. Your hassle ends here.
  • 🔳 Custom button color: Pick your favorite color for the stock buttons. It has a custom button color option.
  • 📊 Increase Sales: By displaying stock status on the front-end, the plugin will create social proof of a busy store with many customers and orders. Get your customers’ requests for stock on your stores as well. Acquire faith. Increase sales. Earn more.
  • 📜 Default country selection: Free your customers from the hassle of choosing a country code every time they request a product stock. Choose a preferred default country from the plugin settings, and it will set the corresponding country code by default on the product page.
  • 📊 Stock progress bar: Displays a gorgeous stock progress bar on the products page with helpful information, including how many products are left in stock. It can help the customers learn more about your product’s popularity and result in more sales.

👁️ View Demo | 🚀 Get PRO | 👩🏼‍💻 Get Support | 🤝 Join Our Facebook Community

🔥 More Awesome Plugins

If you like Stock Notifier, then consider checking out our other awesome projects:

  • 📝 FormyChat – Send contact form leads to WhatsApp chat. This WhatsApp notification plugin makes it easy to manage contact forms. Quick, easy and no coding required.

  • 🔄 FlexStock – Stock Sync with Google Sheet – Auto-sync WooCommerce products from Google Sheets. Flex Stock is an easy, powerful, and simple inventory management system to handle your WooCommerce products.

  • 🛒 Order Sync with Google Sheet – FlexOrder – Manage WooCommerce orders from Google Sheets. Order sync, e-commerce order management, and sales order management with Google Sheets.

  • 🟢 FlexTable – Sheets To WP Table Live Sync – Google Sheets allows you to input data on your Google sheet and show the same data on WordPress as a table effortlessly. Try Flex Table now!

  • 🎁 EchoRewards – With Echo Rewards, you can refer a friend to launch your customer referral program. Echo Rewards Referral Plugin is a referral plugin to boost your sales. Generate coupons, reward customers, and launch the ideal refer-a-friend program for your store.

  • 🌓 WP Dark Mode – Use WP Dark Mode plugin to create a stunning dark version for your WordPress website. WP Dark Mode works automatically without going into any complicated settings.

  • 📽️ Webinar & Video Conference with Jitsi Meet – WordPress video conference plugin and live video chat solution. Get shortcode support with WooCommerce and BuddyPress integration.

Privacy Policy

Stock Notifier for WooCommerce uses Appsero SDK to collect some telemetry data upon user’s confirmation. This helps us to troubleshoot problems faster & make product improvements.

Appsero SDK does not gather any data by default. The SDK only starts gathering basic telemetry data when a user allows it via the admin notice. We collect the data to ensure a great user experience for all our users.

Integrating Appsero SDK DOES NOT IMMEDIATELY start gathering data, without confirmation from users in any case.

Learn more about how Appsero collects and uses this data.
sections.faq:
How to activate Stock Notifier for WooCommerce on my website?

Check how to install and use the Stock Notifier for Woocommerce plugin.

Is Stock Notifier compatible with my theme?

Absolutely. Stock Notifier is super compatible with any theme.

Is Stock Notifier compatible with all modern browsers?

Yes. We have tested this plugin in all modern browsers (Safari, Chrome, Firefox, Edge, etc.), and it works without any issue.

Where can I find the tutorials about using the plugin?

Please visit our Youtube playlist to watch tutorials on different exciting features of Stock Notifier.

How to activate the chat API for Stock Notifier?

Check how to activate the chat API Stock Notifier .

How to activate the Ultramsg API for Stock Notifier?

Check how to activate the Ultramsg API for Stock Notifier

Can I send stock notifications to the customer’s phones?

Yes, you can do that easily with the plugin’s WP SMS integration.Check this feature in action.

Can I test your plugin before making a purchase?

Kindly visit this WPPOOL demo builder website to test our plugins.

Can I use Stock Notifier without using any Whatsapp gateway?

I’m afraid no. It is essential to use Stock Notifier.

I need to collect specific vendor data.

You can collect your vendor data specifically from the dashboard.

Can I send message notifications manually to customers?

Sure. You can easily send messages manually from the plugin dashboard.
